title: The Current State of AI Bias Bounties: An Overview of Existing Programmes and Research
reasoning: The paper is an overview of AI bias bounty programmes and research, which are mechanisms specifically designed for the ethical evaluation and auditing of AI systems. It covers topics such as 'trustworthy AI', 'responsible AI', 'ethical AI', and 'algorithmic fairness', and discusses harms related to underrepresented groups and queer perspectives.
